name: The Schoolhouse
description: Each teacher at the schoolhouse leads a different class in a different room. Work out who teaches what, and where.
clues: Jonah goes with none of Ames, Frost, or Chemistry.
Ames, Geography, and Kira belong to different classes.
Hale goes with either Geography or Jonah (but not both).
French, Jonah, and Scouts belong to different classes.
Rowing goes with exactly two of Ames, French, and Kira.
Chemistry goes with exactly two of Hale, Iris, and Drama.
